subject: Scheduling: ML coding session + interviewer lineup
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jiang <alex.jiang@example.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-14T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduling: ML coding session + interviewer lineup

Hi Alex —

Thanks for your interest in the ML Engineer role and for sharing your availability. We’d like to schedule a 75-minute technical screen (coding + short ML design) the week of Aug 16. Proposed slots (all PT):

- Tue Aug 17, 10:00–11:15
- Wed Aug 18, 14:00–15:15
- Thu Aug 19, 09:30–10:45

Please let me know which slot works best and whether you prefer CoderPad (recommended) or VS Code Live Share. We usually have one interviewer focus on the coding prompt and another ask system/design follow-ups; I've cc'd Karthik and Ben for slot matching.

Prep notes (short):
- Bring a laptop with Python 3.9+
- We'll ask you to write and run code on CoderPad; small design discussion afterwards
- No need to pre-submit anything

Attaching your resume (we had the copy from your application) and the candidate-facing prompt we’ll use. If you have any accessibility or tooling preferences, tell me and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- alex_jiang_resume.pdf (application resume)
- ml_coding_problem_v2.md (candidate prompt, internal copy)
From: Alex Jiang <alex.jiang@example.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-14T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: ML coding session + interviewer lineup

Hi Mina —

Thanks — Wed Aug 18, 14:00–15:15 PT works great for me. I’d prefer VS Code Live Share if that’s possible; I find it easier to run my local tests. If CoderPad is strongly preferred, I can use that as well.

One quick question: will there be a short take-home or is everything live? Also, do you expect me to install any packages beforehand?

Best,
Alex
alex.jiang@example.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Jiang <alex.jiang@example.com>
Date: 2027-08-14T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Scheduling: ML coding session + interviewer lineup

Team — Alex confirmed Wed 8/18 at 14:00 PT and prefers VS Code Live Share but is OK with CoderPad if we need it. Can we run with the following assignment:

- Karthik: coding + unit-test focus (primary) — 45 mins
- Ben: ML systems/design + follow-ups — 20–25 mins
- Kimberly: backup / debrief (on-call) — join as observer for the first 10 mins in case of no-shows

Platform decision: I’m fine supporting VS Code Live Share if Karthik wants to run tests locally; otherwise we’ll default to CoderPad. If we do Live Share, Ben will drive a Zoom session and Karthik will share a Live Share link.

I’ve attached the candidate prompt and the resume we have. Alex explicitly asked about installing packages — we should limit the prompt so local installs aren’t necessary (use stdlib + numpy). If we need a specific library, confirm before Wed.

Proposed links (provisional):
- CoderPad: https://coderpad.io/r/abcd-ml-session-2027
- Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/999888777?pwd=screening
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MLScreenAssets
- Calendar event (invited candidate): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=mlscreen-alex-20270814

Please reply with your preference on Live Share vs CoderPad by noon PT so I can lock the calendar and send final instructions to Alex.

Thanks,
Mina

Attachments:
- ml_coding_problem_v2.md
- alex_jiang_resume.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-14T13:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Scheduling: ML coding session + interviewer lineup

Sounds good — I’m fine with VS Code Live Share; I like running the unit tests locally for quicker iteration. Ben, you good to run Zoom and handle design portion?

Kimberly, can you be on standby as Mina suggested and join the Zoom as observer ~14:05 PT in case we need to swap? I’ll post a short checklist in the calendar event (runtime, Python version, small test script to run).

Link for calendar event w/ checklist added: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=mlscreen-alex-20270814

Karthik
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Subject: Confirmed: Wed 8/18 14:00 PT — Live Share + Zoom details

Hi Alex —

Great — you’re confirmed for Wed Aug 18, 14:00–15:15 PT. We’ll run via VS Code Live Share + Zoom. Please do the following to prepare:

- Confirm you can join Zoom at this link: https://zoom.us/j/999888777?pwd=screening
- Have Python 3.9+ and numpy available (no other installs required)
- Optional: open VS Code and install Live Share extension before the session

On the day we’ll:
- 0–5m: quick intros and environment check
- 5–50m: coding prompt (Karthik will ask you to implement + run small tests)
- 50–75m: ML systems/design + follow-ups with Ben

If anything changes or you need an earlier slot, reply here and we’ll try to accommodate.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
